Huinkers named 2026 4-H Hall of Fame recipients

By Crystal Busch
on August 02, 2026

FacebookTwitterEmailMessengerCopy LinkMessageShare

Winneshiek County 4-H Youth Development Committee members recognized Wayne and Roxanne Huinker with the 2026 Winneshiek County 4-H Hall of Fame Award during the 2026 Winneshiek County Fair. (Photo submitted)

0:00 / 2:49
Instaread

Local 4-H organizers said Wayne and Roxanne Huinker have dedicated decades of service, leadership and mentorship to the Winneshiek County 4-H program and the livestock industry. The couple was chosen as outstanding nominees to represent Winneshiek County in the 2026 Iowa 4-H Hall of Fame. 

Wayne Huinker’s involvement in 4-H began as a youth member of the Calmar Champions and Ossian All-Stars, where he participated for nine years showing swine at both the Winneshiek County Fair and the Iowa State Fair. During his very first year showing pigs, he earned champion individual and champion pen of three honors at the county fair, sparking a lifelong passion for the swine industry and youth development. 

He began raising pigs with his Uncle Dave Huinker from 1977-1981 and started selling 4-H pigs in 1978. In 1981, he and Roxanne established their own farming operation and have continued selling 4-H pigs locally and nationally for more than four decades. Organizers said the Huinkers have positively impacted countless youth by helping young exhibitors learn responsibility, animal care, sportsmanship and leadership. 

Wayne Huinker has served as the Winneshiek County Swine Co-Superintendent since 2021 and was a member of the Winneshiek County Youth Development Committee from 2020-2025. Both Huinkers have been dedicated fair volunteers, assisting with swine and beef weigh-ins for many years and supporting youth exhibitors in countless ways, according to organizers. Wayne Huinker has also been instrumental in growing the county hog show through increased participation, improved quality and expanded opportunities for exhibitors. He helped coordinate buyers for the Winneshiek County Fair Auction for many years and played a key role in supporting the new wash rack and pen updates in the hog barn following the passing of Scott Stendel.  

His expertise in the swine industry is recognized nationally. He has judged swine shows at 24 Iowa county fairs, multiple county fairs in other states and five state fairs including Minnesota, Wisconsin, Texas, Oklahoma and South Dakota. He has also judged prestigious national youth stock shows, including Louisville, San Angelo, Fort Worth, Sioux Falls, World Pork Expo and the National Barrow Show.  

Roxanne Huinker has also been a dedicated supporter of 4-H and youth programs, organizer said. She served as the leader of the Washington Prairie Peppers 4-H Club from 1995-2003 while their three daughters were active members. She has clerked Static Exhibit Day and the county swine show for many years and previously served as both a member and president of the Winneshiek County Fair Board. 

Wayne and Roxanne Huinker were awarded the Winneshiek County 4-H Hall of Fame award at the 2026 Winneshiek County 4-H/FFA Livestock Auction, which took place on Saturday, July 18 at the Winneshiek County Fair. They will be inducted into the Iowa 4-H Hall of Fame on the last day of the Iowa State Fair.
